_comment: Port -> identity map for the dev fleet. One port is one signed-in person.
Edit this file to change who a port becomes; restart that port to apply.
This file is DEV ONLY and is never promoted to the main system.

ports.label: Clinic owner
ports.purpose: Full clinic control: settings, staff, billing, audit

ports.label: Receptionist
ports.purpose: Front desk: issue tokens, call, complete — no clinical priority

ports.label: Doctor
ports.purpose: Own queue only, start session, set priority with a reason

ports.label: Platform admin
ports.purpose: Tenants, plans, feature gates, payment verification, groups

ports.label: Second clinic (isolation)
ports.purpose: Proves tenant isolation — must never see Serenity's patients
